description: A real adopter's stack: the latest plMail release tag (karatektus/pl_mail), cloned unchanged, then flisk import --yes, flisk export compose --check and flisk up. The import must keep its compose.yaml and committed .env untouched, keep the Compose volume names (pl_mail_*), the worker's mercure alias, the stop grace period, the disabled worker healthcheck, the push profile and the variable ports; the stack must come up and answer / with a redirect to /login.
checkName: ✉️ plMail latest release imports and runs
